annotations.title: Create a one-time site transfer link

description: Creates a one-time link that hands a managed site to a departing client: they sign in or sign up and accept, and the site (and, by default, its domain) moves to their account. The link works once and expires at expires_at; creating a new one cancels the previous one. Signed-in accounts only.

include_domain.description: Move the site's connected domain with it (default true). When false the site moves unpublished and the domain stays with this account.

site_key.description: The managed site to hand over to a departing client.
